title: Power to the Clients: Federated Learning in a Dictatorship Setting

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the classification accuracy and loss of the global federated learning model on individual clients' highly non-IID local datasets (using MNIST, CIFAR-10, and AG News) to measure the extent to which the model favors the malicious 'dictator' client's data while erasing the contributions of benign clients.
